_note: The Stage 5 constraint rules actually used for the 2023 CBC by GuidedPlanningEngine — adapted from cdc_constraints.example.json now that real activity-bank data exists (see assets/activity_banks/). 'locked_template_sections' documents which lesson-plan form fields must never be left blank, per assets/rules/README.md's design; the guided Q&A engine below only adjusts suggested activities/group size, so it does not yet enforce this list against the form itself — that's a separate, not-yet-built check.

rules.description: A substituted activity must still map to at least one competency already listed for this topic or sub-topic.
Group size must stay between 2 and 8 learners regardless of the class-size answer given, so it remains a workable group activity.
If the teacher reports no teaching aids are available, only activities tagged for no special aids (or foundational ones) may be selected.
An activity marked foundational in the activity bank can never be dropped by an answer, even one implying high prior mastery or no teaching aids available.
Preferred activity style (e.g. group work vs individual) may reorder candidate activities but never removes the only activity covering a mandatory competency.
